adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now loops over `event.destinationCalendar` to create one event per destination/host. However, `Office365CalendarService.createEvent` was updated to destructure only the first element (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []`) and uses that to choose the API URL, with no per-credential/per-destination selection logic. Since the loop passes the same `event` (containing the full array) to each provider call, Office365 will repeatedly create events on the first destination calendar rather than the destination corresponding to the current credential/host. This matches the finding’s core claim (even aside from the separate interface mismatch that `createEvent` now expects a `credentialId`).
